introduction: Vermont weatherization improves home energy efficiency, safety and comfort through approved services. Regional agencies handle applications.
description: Vermont weatherization improves home energy efficiency, safety and comfort through approved services. Regional agencies handle applications.

sections.who: DCF lists no free weatherization within the prior 15 years plus an income or qualifying-benefit route. Active Fuel Assistance, SSI or qualifying adult Reach Up benefits can establish eligibility; child-only Reach Up does not.
sections.get: Approved services include a home assessment and energy improvements rather than unrestricted cash.
sections.docs:
• Agency application and signature.
  • Requested household income or benefit evidence.
  • Form 407 for each applicable wage job in the previous 12 months.
sections.apply:
1. Find the regional agency

    Use the service-area links on DCF Weatherization.

  2. Complete agency forms

    Fill the application and required employee sections of employment-verification forms.

  3. Submit signed records

    Use the address on the application. Ask about extra forms if the home has separate living areas.
sections.after: Discuss scheduling, property permission and assessment findings with the agency before work begins.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DCF weatherization. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
